title: UNDER THE FIG TREE, I SAW YOU

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: Nathanael asked Him, “How do You know me?” Jesus answered and said to him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.” (John 1:48)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Jesus saw Nathanael while he was under the fig tree. The tree itself was not very important, but what mattered was that Jesus knew exactly where Nathanael was and openly declared it. This reveals the loving nature of our Lord: before others notice you, God finds you exactly where you are.
He does not look at you to accuse you, but to call you, comfort you, shape you, make you a disciple, empower you, and use you for His purpose. Even when the eyes of others do not fall on you, He is always at work with deep concern for you.
If you ever think that God is not paying attention to you, that thought is not from God, but a deceptive lie from the enemy. God’s silence is not His absence. His quietness is not His inability. His delay is not denial. Before He speaks, He patiently and silently watches.
God did not fail to see Jonah even when he was sleeping in the lower part of the ship. Zacchaeus was not hidden when he was sitting on the branch of a wild fig tree.
Wherever you are today, you are not hidden from His sight. He sees your hidden tears and your silent pain. Your failures, ups and downs, struggles, and disappointments are all known to Him. At the appointed time, He will meet you personally.
The right time for you is waiting. Your vision will surely be attended to.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God’s delays are not God’s denials.” - A. W. Tozer

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I thank You for knowing me fully and loving me completely. Grant me the grace to wait patiently for Your time and to move forward in faith. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Keep your heart in a ready condition. Stand firmly on His path. Pray and wait for the Lord. His rescue is never hidden. His grace is unlimited. His mercy toward you endures forever.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: Knowing God
recommended_book.author: J. I. Packer
recommended_book.quote: “God knows us completely. He knows our weaknesses, our failures, and our hidden fears. Yet this knowledge does not lead Him to reject us; rather, it causes Him to establish us in His grace.”
